title: Great Wolf Lodge: The Wand Hall
opening: Liza arrives at the cozy Wand Hall inside Great Wolf Lodge. Luma has a wand waiting just for her.
not_yet: Your magic is safe. Look for the landmark in your clue and try a gentle wave there.
ending: Thank you, Liza. All three landmarks know your wand, and the Wand Hall is glowing. You are ready for the Fairy Pools! Come back to practice whenever you like.

steps.title: Your very own wand
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: Welcome to Great Wolf Lodge, Liza. This is the Wand Hall! Here is your wand. Hold the handle and point the tip toward a clear landmark. Shall we see which magic answers?

steps.title: A light in the Moon Crystal
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: Visit the Moon Crystal. Point your wand at its little listening window and give one gentle wave. Watch for a sparkle.

steps.title: The wand chose you
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: It answered! Your wand chose you, Liza. A small wave is enough. You do not need to touch the landmark. Let us meet the other two.

steps.title: Wake the Elder Tree
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: Find the Elder Tree. Point at its listening window and wave once. The old tree has been waiting to say hello.

steps.title: A secret in the Treasure Chest
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: Now find the Treasure Chest. Point at its listening window and wave once. Something bright is hiding inside!

steps.title: Little waves build big magic
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: All three landmarks know your wand. Now we will practice Glowmend. We will build it with three slow, separate waves at the Moon Crystal. Let the sparkle settle between waves.

steps.title: Three slow sparks
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: At the Moon Crystal, wave three separate times. Let the sparkle settle; count one, two before each new wave. Watch your practice spell fill.

steps.title: Follow the next clue
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: You made a little healing light! Come back to me at the TV whenever a friend has something to say. When a clue names a landmark, carry your wand to that place. Our next trail is Elder Tree, Treasure Chest, Moon Crystal.

steps.title: The Wand Hall trail
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: First the Elder Tree, then the Treasure Chest, then the Moon Crystal. Wave once at each in that order. A different landmark starts this little trail again. We can try as often as you like.

steps.title: One last little hunt
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: You followed the whole trail! This time, choose your own order. A Moon Spark, a Leaf Spark, and a Treasure Spark are waiting at our three landmarks. Find all three, then come back to the TV.

steps.title: Choose your own path
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: Find one spark at each landmark. Moon Crystal, Elder Tree, Treasure Chest: any order you like. Wave once at each. A spark you already found will stay safe.

steps.title: Liza, Wand Hall apprentice
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: Three sparks, one wonderful wand keeper! You can wake a landmark, build a spell, follow a trail, and find things your own way. Your practice Glowmend can rest now. The fairies will teach you its full magic when your real adventure begins.
